proposal: Use relation-bearing language tokens to route raw paired-2D identity evidence through candidate masks into the referent decision.

rejection_reasons.finding: The raw 2D modality has a measured identity-separability advantage, but its same-forward referent-language alignment is at chance: top-5 is 6.1% for mean and max pooling, and prefers-target is 51.5%/57.6% on 33 recoverable failures. The proposed transport would route a signal whose referential identity is not established.

RefMask3D already performs Geometry-Enhanced Group-Word Attention between language and geometrically coherent sub-clouds, constructs linguistic primitives, and uses an Object Cluster Module to identify the referred target. Replacing sub-clouds with predicted masks and calling the route relation-conditioned does not define a new causal unit.

Generic target-supervised latent relations are recorded prior art in NS3D/CoT3DRef comparisons. This proposal recombines already-present language, mask, and 2D features; it adds neither a new supervision unit nor a new information source.

The proposal is a modality-fusion/readback mechanism on the closed selector/fusion axis and risks query-by-superpoint cross-modal attention. It has no admissible label or causal falsifier beyond prior mask-aware matching.

resource_testing.reason: Rejected at diagnosis, novelty, mechanism, and constraint gates before implementation.

next_action: Do not reopen under relation-conditioned transport, mask-mediated identity fusion, compact relational attention, or similar names. Continue the blocked native referent diagnostics when GPU capacity opens.
